limitations: This is a read-only assessment of the 59 supplied contact sheets and runtime narrative; no files, source, previous ratings or live application were inspected.
Corresponding transition, normal and 200% captures are grouped with their settled screen; distinct task and recovery states are scored separately.
Scores assess provisional browser quality; reported runtime checks support the assessment but were not independently rerun.

For each item, A is the mean of its applicable first three dimensions, F is the mean of its applicable final three dimensions, and overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1); null denotes a genuinely inapplicable dimension.
The A>=9 and F>=9 threshold for every screen and component is not met; demonstrated browser strengths do not justify raising weaker dimensions to the target.
No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence; content extending beyond a captured viewport is not proof that scrolling or the primary action is inaccessible.
Static transition frames establish visual continuity only partially; they cannot independently establish timing, responsiveness or motion comfort.
Synthetic stress prose, sample forecasts and historical confidence wording were not treated as production-copy defects or evidence of predictive quality.
The 500px captures demonstrate synthetic viewport handling, not operation with a physical phone keyboard.
Native Dynamic Type, physical iPhone Safari, VoiceOver, microphone, haptics, payments and OS sharing remain unverified; no full/native 9/10 certification is given.
Circles is demonstrated only offline; live membership, authentication, invitations and eligibility behavior cannot be graded as proven.
Pressed-state appearance, screen-reader announcements and repeated novice comprehension are not established by the screenshots or supplied summaries.
topFixes: Refine the opening’s black separation wedge; it is the most conspicuous break in the otherwise coherent glass-and-mist treatment.
Tighten 200% vertical composition around forms, evidence and profile screens while preserving full text scaling and scroll access.
Make consent-required submission and Approach progression understandable from the visible state alone.
Give forecast content more priority over sharing and the crowded secondary-action stack.
Standardize secondary navigation, disclosure, input-focus and destructive-action treatments.
Improve long-content scanning through contextual answer headings, identifiable source headings, left-aligned city results and input-overflow cues.
